group: TypeValidator.getSchemaType() returns the schema type that was set

cases.description: When the internal field `schemaType` is set to JsonType.STRING (via reflection or a suitable constructor), getSchemaType() should return JsonType.STRING.
When the internal field `schemaType` is set to JsonType.NUMBER, getSchemaType() should return JsonType.NUMBER.
When the internal field `schemaType` is set to JsonType.INTEGER, getSchemaType() should return JsonType.INTEGER.
When the internal field `schemaType` is set to JsonType.BOOLEAN, getSchemaType() should return JsonType.BOOLEAN.
When the internal field `schemaType` is set to JsonType.OBJECT, getSchemaType() should return JsonType.OBJECT.
When the internal field `schemaType` is set to JsonType.ARRAY, getSchemaType() should return JsonType.ARRAY.
When the internal field `schemaType` is set to JsonType.NULL, getSchemaType() should return JsonType.NULL.
When the internal field `schemaType` has not been initialized (remains null), getSchemaType() should return null.
When a TypeValidator is constructed with a schema node that defines "type":"string", the internal schemaType should be set to JsonType.STRING and getSchemaType() must return JsonType.STRING.
When the schema node defines "type":"number", the validator should initialise schemaType to JsonType.NUMBER; getSchemaType() should return JsonType.NUMBER.
When the schema node defines "type":"integer", getSchemaType() must return JsonType.INTEGER.
When the schema node defines "type":"boolean", getSchemaType() must return JsonType.BOOLEAN.
When the schema node defines "type":"object", getSchemaType() must return JsonType.OBJECT.
When the schema node defines "type":"array", getSchemaType() must return JsonType.ARRAY.
When the schema node defines "type":"null", getSchemaType() must return JsonType.NULL.
When the schema node does not contain a "type" property, the validator cannot infer a schema type; getSchemaType() should return null.
When the schema node contains an unrecognised type string, the validator should leave schemaType unset; getSchemaType() must return null.
When the schema node defines a type array (multiple possible types), the validator does not map it to a single JsonType; getSchemaType() should return null.
Calling getSchemaType() on a null reference of TypeValidator should throw NullPointerException.

When the private field `schemaType` is forcibly set (via reflection) to a value that is not a JsonType (e.g., a String), invoking getSchemaType() should result in a ClassCastException because the returned object cannot be cast to JsonType.
